new.title: New workflow
new.subtitle: Created on {{computer}}.
new.ai.body: A chat reads {{computer}} as needed and writes the workflow. Your chat and reply approval settings, rules and hooks decide whether saving asks you first.
new.ai.empty: Say what the workflow should do.
new.start.unavailable: Can't start a chat on {{computer}} right now.
new.start.waiting: Starting the chat on {{computer}} once the agent panel's last message has settled.
new.start.unknown: This chat may have been started on {{computer}}. Check again reads what happened; it never starts the chat again. Stop tracking frees Send, and sending again may start a second chat.
new.start.unknownNoText: Its message is not kept on this page.
new.start.untracked: If the chat was started, it shows in your chats.
new.start.unlinked: The chat was started. Open it from your chats.
new.start.ready: The chat you started earlier from New workflow is ready on {{computer}}.
new.name: Name
new.name.spaces: Remove the spaces at the start or end.
new.name.dots: That name can't be used. Pick another name.
new.name.reserved: That name is reserved by the agent. Pick another name.
new.taken.same: A workflow named {{name}} is already on {{computer}}. Pick another name.
new.taken.case: A workflow with this name in other letter case is already on {{computer}}. Pick another name.
new.copyFailed: Its source could not be read.
new.problem.object: The definition must be one JSON object.
new.problem.entry: The definition needs an entry_point naming the first step.
new.problem.steps: The definition needs at least one step.
new.problem.tooBig: The definition is larger than 1 MB, more than the agent takes.
new.problem.unknownKey: "{{key}}" is not a workflow field, so the agent would refuse it.
new.problem.type: "{{key}}" has a value of the wrong kind, so the agent would refuse it.
new.problem.blankOutput: The output "{{key}}" needs a template; the agent refuses a blank one.
new.heldReason: Creating {{name}} on {{computer}} may have gone through. Check it first.
new.moved: The computer or realm shown is no longer {{computer}}'s, so nothing here is read or sent. Switch back, or close this and start again.
new.elsewhere: Switch back to {{computer}} in the realm it was created in to check {{name}}.
new.seen.other: A workflow named {{name}} is on {{computer}}, but it isn't the one sent. Creating it may still have gone through first.
new.seen.none: {{name}} isn't on {{computer}} yet. Creating it may still go through.
new.seen.unread: {{name}} could not be read on {{computer}}, so it's still unknown whether it was created.
new.stop.title: Stop tracking {{name}}?
new.stop.body: If it went through, the workflow is on {{computer}}, and Create will then say the name is taken.
new.out.exists: A workflow named {{name}} already exists. Pick another name.
new.out.reserved: That name is reserved by the agent. Pick another name.
new.out.paused: Not created: the agent on {{computer}} is paused.
new.out.refused: Not created: the agent on {{computer}} refused it. Nothing was written.
new.out.unknown: Creating {{name}} on {{computer}} may have gone through. It won't be sent again.
